in_sanskrit.name: भानुमुआर्ति

in_hindi.name: भानुमुआर्ती

in_telugu.name: భానుమూర్తి

in_marathi.name: Bhaanumuarti
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Time
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhaanumuarti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhaanu - God of Time Mau - Mother Marti - Goddess Therefore, Bhaanumuarti is the Goddess who personifies the concept of time.

in_bengali.name: Bhaanumuarti

in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhaanumuarti একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Bhaanu - God of Time Mau - Mother Marti - Goddess Therefore, Bhaanumuarti is the Goddess who personifies the concept of time.
